_about: Self-Made Engineer (Page 2) 'spec sheet' look: steel navy #14212E + safety orange #FF7A1A + off-white #F4F1EA. Navy blueprint-grid header panel (top_shade colour + grid), rotated outline 'BUILD #NN' stamp (--badge, decorative), LEFT-aligned hook: sentence-case off-white setup on the navy panel, ALL-CAPS navy payoff (up to 4 words) on a flat square orange plate with a hazard-stripe band under it. Measured callout = navy sticker with an orange border, orange label (--sticker-label), big off-white number and measuring-tape ticks, plus a thin orange elbow leader ending in a dot on the real build (--arrow x,y with pointer.style leader). No shadows, square corners. Spec + target: page2/branding/THUMBNAIL-PRESET-SME.md, page2/branding/thumb-sample-build01.jpg. Not expressible yet: the round logo, the top hazard strip, the 330 px frame shift and the orange bar left of the setup. Font: Oswald Bold, falling back to Montserrat if the file is missing.
